conclusion: First real MS training-label set produced this session, using the qualified GPT-5.6 primary + Claude Haiku 4.5 challenger pairing and the binary-collapsed exact-agreement-only consensus rule adopted in paper1_ms_qualification_final_decision_v1.json. 127 items now have a real, defensible USE/DO_NOT_USE label; the 61 genuine-disagreement items are correctly left unlabeled rather than forced. 13 items had a transport/schema failure on one side (repair_item_id_mismatch or local semantic validation) and are also unlabeled -- acceptable noise at this scale, not re-run under this identity per the one-shot rule.
